districts.name: Mixed Use Neighborhood-Alternative
districts.quote: is intended for a low intensity mixture of residential, retail, and office uses and is designed to create walkable neighborhoods through the use of appropriate building placement and bulk standards

districts.name: Mixed Use Limited
districts.quote: is intended for a moderate intensity mixture of residential, retail, restaurant, and office uses and is designed to create walkable neighborhoods through the use of appropriate building placement and bulk standards

districts.quote: is intended for a moderately high intensity mixture of residential, retail, and office uses and is designed to create walkable neighborhoods through the use of appropriate building placement and bulk standards

districts.quote: is intended for a high intensity mixture of residential, retail, and office uses and is designed to create walkable neighborhoods through the use of appropriate building placement and bulk standards

districts.name: Office/Residential
districts.quote: is intended for office and/or multi-family residential units at up to 20 dwelling units per acre

districts.name: Office/Residential-Alternative

districts.name: Commercial Limited
districts.quote: is intended for retail, consumer service, financial, restaurant, and office uses

districts.name: Commercial Service
districts.quote: is intended for retail, consumer service, financial, restaurant, office, self-service storage, light manufacturing, and small warehouse uses

districts.name: Industrial Restrictive
districts.quote: is intended for a wide range of light manufacturing uses at moderate intensities within enclosed structures

districts.name: Industrial Warehousing/Distribution
districts.quote: is intended for a wide range of warehousing, wholesaling, and bulk distribution uses

districts.name: Specific Plan
districts.quote: is a zoning district category that provides for additional flexibility of design, including the relationship of streets to buildings, to provide the ability to implement the specific details of the General Plan
